content: Simply marvelous, Thorne! I shall expect your invitations to arrive via the Aether-Net henceforth rather than by tiresome courier.
The latency on the Aether-Net is remarkably low for such high-altitude transmissions. Truly, the laws of thermodynamics have never been so well-applied.
A noble advancement for British trade, provided the Aether-Net bandwidth remains strictly regulated by the Crown.
